items.name: Warm Quinoa Carrot Chickpea Bowl
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it with the water until tender; rest covered for eight minutes.
Prepare the carrot, diced and cooked chickpeas and fresh cilantro and cook any raw vegetable topping until just tender.
Toast the cumin, then whisk it with the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and rock salt.
Divide the warm grain among bowls and arrange the toppings over it.
Spoon over the dressing immediately and serve the bowl warm, not chilled.
items.guidance: Warm Quinoa Carrot Chickpea Bowl is assembled and served warm, with oil-citrus dressing added at the end. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
